Who We Are
 Everything at BMW TechWorks Romania begins with passion. It transforms a job into a calling. It motivates us to continually reinvent mobility and bring new ideas to life and onto the roads. Passion for collaborative projects turns a team into a strong unit where every viewpoint is appreciated.
Whatever You Aspire To, At BMW TechWorks Romania We Live And Breathe Software And We Offer a Wide Variety Of Departments And Fields Where You Can Share Your Professional Passion With Us. We search for excellence

 Join BMW TechWorks Romania on our journey of innovation and excellence as we redefine the future of motion, one product at a time. Our engineers are vital to the innovation and digitalization of BMW Group's driving machines, production, sales and banking processes, and you could be part of our evolving teams.
Main Job Responsibilities
Industrial Automation & PLC Programming
Embedded Software & Hardware Development
Middleware Solutions
Cross-Functional Collaboration
2nd Level Support and On-Call
 What Awaits You
Design, develop, and maintain PLC programs using Ladder Logic, Structured Text, and Function Block Diagrams.
Integrate PLCs with sensors, actuators, HMIs, and industrial networks (Ethernet/IP, Modbus, Profibus).
Troubleshoot and optimize control systems for reliability and performance.
Collaborate with hardware teams for board bring-up, interfacing, and validation.
Configure middleware components to enable communication between industrial systems and enterprise applications.
Work with messaging platforms (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, MQTT) and integration frameworks.
Ensure middleware performance, security, and high availability in distributed environments.
Work closely with automation, hardware, and software teams to deliver integrated solutions.
Document system architecture, interfaces, and operational procedures.
 What Should You Bring Along
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
PLC programming (Siemens, Allen-Bradley, Schneider).
Embedded development (C/C++, RTOS, microcontrollers).
Middleware technologies (Kafka, RabbitMQ, MQTT, WebSphere).
Familiarity with industrial protocols and networking standards.
Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
Experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) is a plus.
Experience in Building Automation
Experience in Input and Output Logic
 What do we offer?
Challenging projects with which we are shaping the mobility of tomorrow. 
Great team spirit within an international team 
State-of-the-art global IT landscape and processes 
100% implementation of the Agile Working Model methodology 
Wide range of personal & professional development opportunities 
High level of job security 
Work-Life-Balance and flexible working hours. 
Dynamic and highly-motivating work environment
